market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People holds only 13 seats and faces competition from larger, more established parties that could also gain seats. The Kremlin tightly manages elections, making a dramatic surge for this minor party unlikely; true probability of them being the top gainer is far lower than the 28.7% implied by the market.
evidence_points: In the 2021 Duma election, New People won 13 seats from zero, but the Communist Party gained 15 seats and was the biggest gainer.
United Russia currently holds 324 seats and is more likely to lose seats than gain, so the largest gain will come from a smaller party, but New People must outpace all others.
Russian electoral engineering typically favors United Russia or manageable opposition, not outsized gains for a single minor pro-Kremlin party.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Russian political dynamics
